label: corrected-100k-timestamp-roundtrip
sql:
SELECT count_if(NOT(published_at <=> cast(get_json_object(payload,'$.published_at') AS TIMESTAMP))),
 min(unix_micros(published_at)-unix_micros(cast(get_json_object(payload,'$.published_at') AS TIMESTAMP))),
 max(unix_micros(published_at)-unix_micros(cast(get_json_object(payload,'$.published_at') AS TIMESTAMP)))
 FROM (SELECT published_at,to_json(named_struct('source_system',source_system,'rel_type_id',rel_type_id,'id',id,'source_type',source_type,'source_id',source_id,'target_type',target_type,'target_id',target_id,'schema_revision',schema_revision,'entity_version',entity_version,'props_json',props_json,'retained_json',retained_json,'order_key',order_key,'source_feed',source_feed,'source_epoch',source_epoch,'source_position',source_position,'published_at',published_at,'lookup_hash',lookup_hash,'apply_batch_id',apply_batch_id,'source_cursor_json',source_cursor_json,'source_delivery_id',source_delivery_id,'old_json',old_json),map('ignoreNullFields','false','timestampFormat',decode(unhex('797979792d4d4d2d646427542748483a6d6d3a73732e535353535353585858'),'UTF-8'),'timeZone','UTC')) payload FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.publication_stage_r94 VERSION AS OF 0)

label: microsecond-and-pre-epoch-oracles
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM
 (SELECT ts,to_json(named_struct('time',ts,'bag','{"102":9007199254740993,"103":1.2300000000000000001}'),map('ignoreNullFields','false','timestampFormat',decode(unhex('797979792d4d4d2d646427542748483a6d6d3a73732e535353535353585858'),'UTF-8'),'timeZone','UTC')) payload FROM (SELECT timestamp '2026-10-06 12:34:56.123456' ts
 UNION ALL SELECT timestamp '1969-12-31 23:59:59.987654' ts))
 WHERE NOT(ts <=> cast(get_json_object(payload,'$.time') AS TIMESTAMP))
 OR NOT(hex(encode(get_json_object(payload,'$.bag'),'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode('{"102":9007199254740993,"103":1.2300000000000000001}','UTF-8')))

label: legacy-r89-published-at-loss
sql:
SELECT count_if(NOT(s.published_at <=> cast(get_json_object(r.payload_json,'$.published_at') AS TIMESTAMP))),
 min(unix_micros(s.published_at)-unix_micros(cast(get_json_object(r.payload_json,'$.published_at') AS TIMESTAMP))),
 max(unix_micros(s.published_at)-unix_micros(cast(get_json_object(r.payload_json,'$.published_at') AS TIMESTAMP)))
 FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.publication_stage_r89 VERSION AS OF 0 s JOIN client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.source_record_r89 VERSION AS OF 1 r
 ON s.source_feed=r.source_feed AND s.source_epoch=r.source_epoch AND s.source_delivery_id=r.delivery_id
